name: Meta Ads
verdict: Managing other people's ad accounts needs Advanced Access through App Review, which requires Business Verification. Full Marketing API access also needs 500 successful calls in 15 days; likely 3-8 weeks, unconfirmed.
needGuide: Yes — start Business Verification early, then App Review, and plan for the Full access activity requirement.

auth.detail: Facebook Login OAuth dialog with scope parameter (ads_read, ads_management); user clicks Allow. Token lifetimes were not on the pages read; commonly short-lived tokens are exchanged for ~60-day long-lived tokens, and system-user tokens exist for business-level access (from general knowledge, unverified here).

effort.timeToFirstTest: 1-2 hours (dev mode, app role users only)
effort.timeToProduction: unknown; likely 3-8 weeks (Business Verification plus one or more App Review rounds plus the 15-day activity requirement)

approval.gate: Managing other people's ad accounts needs Advanced Access to ads_read and/or ads_management via App Review, and Advanced Access requires Business Verification (since 2023-02-01). Separately, the Marketing API tier starts at Limited access (development only, heavily rate-limited, not for live advertisers) and upgrades to Full access after App Review plus 500 successful Marketing API calls in the last 15 days with under 15% errors over the last 500.

scopes.why: ads_read and ads_management need Advanced Access through App Review to serve other businesses.
scopes.summary: ads_read (read ad data) and ads_management (create and edit ads). Standard Access is enough only for your own ad accounts; both need Advanced Access to serve other businesses. Related permissions such as business_management or page permissions (not covered by pages read) likely need review as well.

prerequisites: Account and owner: Developer with a personal Facebook login who is an Administrator on the app and an Admin of the company's Business (portfolio). Use a company-owned Business, not a personal one.

Where you register: My Apps -> Create App -> choose the Marketing API (create and manage ads) use case; App settings -> Basic for App ID/secret; Use cases -> Customize -> Permissions and features; App Review -> Permissions and Features
Cost: Free (customers pay for ad spend)

registerAt.path: My Apps -> Create App -> choose the Marketing API (create and manage ads) use case; App settings -> Basic for App ID/secret; Use cases -> Customize -> Permissions and features; App Review -> Permissions and Features

steps.do: Register as Meta developer and create an app with the Marketing API use case in the App Dashboard, owned by the company Business
Settings -> Basic: add privacy policy URL, app icon, data deletion URL; set Valid OAuth Redirect URIs
Settings -> Basic -> Verification -> Start Verification; Business Admin completes Business Verification with legal documents
Implement OAuth with scope ads_read,ads_management; exchange for long-lived tokens; test with role users and own ad accounts
App Review -> Permissions and Features: request Advanced Access for ads_read/ads_management with screencast of the full login-to-ad-action flow and reviewer test instructions
Switch app to Live; generate at least 500 successful Marketing API calls in 15 days with under 15% errors to reach Full tier
Keep traffic steady: Advanced Access lapses if the 500-calls-in-15-days and under 15% error rule is not maintained

roles.team: Developer with a personal Facebook login who is an Administrator on the app and an Admin of the company's Business (portfolio). Use a company-owned Business, not a personal one.
roles.console: App Dashboard -> App roles -> Roles -> Add People (Administrators, Developers, Testers). Only a Business Admin can finish Business Verification, though any app Administrator can link the app to a Business.
roles.customer: A person with a role on the ad account (admin or advertiser, via their Business portfolio) who grants permission in the OAuth dialog. Business-level admins can restrict who holds ad account roles (likely).

testing: Until approved, only people with a role on the app can grant permissions (dev mode).
Limited tier allows 1 system user plus 1 admin system user; Full allows 10 plus 1.
Both tiers can reach unlimited ad accounts.
A Marketing API sandbox may exist but was not confirmed.

blockers.problem: Advanced Access is blocked until Business Verification completes
blockers.fix: Start it first because only a Business Admin can finish it.

blockers.problem: App Review rejects the whole submission if Meta cannot access the app
blockers.fix: Provide working test credentials and a complete screencast.
Permission levels (Standard/Advanced) versus Marketing API tiers (Limited/Full, renamed from Standard/Advanced); the Full tier needs 500 calls in 15 days and an error rate under 15%.

blockers.problem: Limited tier is for development only and heavily rate-limited
blockers.fix: Do not onboard live advertisers on it.

automation.agentCan: Write OAuth and token-exchange code, generate call volume and monitor error rates, draft App Review use-case descriptions per permission, test-instruction text and screencast scripts, run test calls.
automation.humanMust: Business Verification (legal documents, Business Admin), login and 2FA, recording the screencast, accepting platform terms, submitting App Review.

uncertain: Business Verification and App Review timelines, token lifetimes, sandbox availability and exact current use-case names were not on the pages read; search budget ran out, so no community timelines were checked.
